CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: Fixed a real, live Windows CI failure on the 16-card system commit: the Windows cross-compile step's own link command was missing card_effect_mod_host.h/card_effect_mod.c, the same recurring 'third separate build path missed' bug class already hit twice before (bloodflower_mod, tree_passive_mod). Verified with a real local mingw cross-compile against the exact SDL2 mingw package CI downloads. ECOWAR commit ed369bb, Apple #16405. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
